t: OVX - The volatility index for oil - CapTrader - Ihr Online-Broker
s: March 24, 2024 - The Cboe Crude Oil ETF Volatility Index (briefly: OVX, due to the ticker symbol) measures the market's expected short-term Fluctuation range (implied volatility) of oil prices. The same method is used to calculate the VIX and the option prices of the United States Oil Fund (USO) are used to calculate the index. The United States Oil Fund ETF with the abbreviation USO was launched on April 10, 2006, with the objective of Oil price by buying forward contracts (futures) on crude oil (WTI) and rolling them continuously.
